response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff-level engineer with a strong background in high-scale distributed systems, AI-agent infrastructure, and full-stack development. However, while he meets the general technical requirements and AI preferences, his resume lacks demonstrated experience in building growth, telemetry, or experimentation platforms (such as A/B testing, feature flagging, and statistical analysis), which are the core focus of this Principal role.
strengths: Over 15 years of software engineering experience, including building high-scale distributed systems handling millions of requests per second.
Recent hands-on experience building AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling, aligning well with the AI-first focus of the team.
Proven technical leadership and engineering excellence, demonstrated through open-source contributions, test-driven development, and organizing technical workshops.
concerns: No explicitly mentioned experience architecting or working with experimentation frameworks, feature-flagging systems, or A/B testing platforms.
Lacks demonstrated background in telemetry foundations, data analysis, and statistical methods required for experimentation quality and bias detection.
While experienced at the Staff level, the candidate's recent roles may not demonstrate the cross-organizational scope and stakeholder alignment typically expected at the Principal (IC6) level.
